title: PRODUCE SUPPLIES
frontText:
PRODUCE SUPPLIES
For an action, do one of the following:
• Local Production: at a haven or supply center, fill your current location to its population with Supply cubes.
OR
• System-Wide Production: at a haven or supply center, fill all havens and supply centers to their population with Supply cubes.
• Then, check a box below.
When all boxes are checked, destroy this card.

rules: This copy starts on the 2-checkbox face (cardId 111).
Played as an action. Choose Local Production or System-Wide Production.
Local Production: at a haven or supply center, fill your current location to its population with Supply cubes.
System-Wide Production: at a haven or supply center, fill all havens and supply centers to their population with Supply cubes. The word all is italic.
OR is printed on a divider between the two options.
The check instruction is its own bullet after System-Wide Production.
The destroy line is a yellow footer.
Every checkbox on these scans is empty. The state images change how many boxes are printed, not which boxes are marked.
The 1-box, 2-box, and 3-box artworks are shared by cardId 110, 111, and 112. Each Produce Supplies object starts on a different artwork.
